structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation reinforces how a compact apartment can be personalized into distinct yet open, light-filled bedroom and dining zones.
structured_intent.primary_action: The spatial relationship between the bedroom and dining zones is progressively revealed around the timber divider.
structured_intent.terminal_state: Both the bedroom and dining zones are clearly readable together, with the timber divider intact and all room elements unchanged.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The apartment remains a rigid, orderly two-zone interior with an intact timber divider, unchanged furniture, and completely still curtains.

prompt.positive: Camera makes one slow stabilized move to the right with a slight push-in toward the central timber divider. Gentle parallax reveals the bedroom and dining zones while all curtains remain perfectly still and the architecture and furniture stay rigid. End with both zones visible around the unchanged divider.
